link_cardinality: One Global Sense to N Sense–Scene associations; all contexts retained
identification_rules: Require headword+POS+semantics(gloss/sense reference) and substantive independent alignment to Chinese meaning
Use canonical ID only when real identity is explicitly verified; unresolved retain candidate_group_not_sense_id and HOLD, not a fabricated ID
A single Global Sense may link multiple Scene–Sense records, but its lexical/semantic core is not multiplied in the 3000-sense production count
Each scene association retains scene-specific bilingual examples 1–3, usage, collocations and cue
batch_boundary: Continue scanning forward until 3000 verified-distinct Global Sense identities have been produced; HOLD candidates and duplicated associations do not count toward the target. If the available inspected Master range is exhausted, mark partial instead of fabricating counts.
release_policy: Production can proceed in isolated staging. Global Sense production validation is not the same as dual-AI QA certification. No SRS/Ready until approved.

historical_reconciliation.V182_to_V185: Historical 3000 count is Sense–Scene association rows, NOT 3000 Global Senses
historical_reconciliation.warning: Do not retrospectively label the first 3000 rows as the first 3000 unique senses or reset source-final-row progress.
